reviews.text: Rima was very professional, gave us great advice on how to control our dog on walks. She was very helpful with helping us teach our dog to react to our commands. Overall, a great experience which has paid off with helping our dog be more calm.

Rima's support has been invaluable in helping me understand my little reactive rescue.
I was pretty desperate by the time I found Rima, and she helped me calm everything down, gave me the tools to make things more manageable and build up my confidence.
She's been so reassuring and encouraging, and I cannot thank her enough.
Freddie is a much happier dog and I am a much happier dog owner, thanks to Rima!
She is really flexible and somehow could always sense when a check-in would be helpful! I would highly recommend Rima.

We have a puppy training session and six follow-up sessions with Rima and she was brilliant at ensuring we were managing everything correctly in those first weeks as first-time dog owners. Rima was absolutely wonderful with our Glen of Imaal puppy Tadgh and her lessons and advice were just what we needed to teach him all the essential tricks and training.

Overdue review.

Rima is a great behaviorist. Over a year ago, in 2024, when I got a miniature Dachshund (Raye) after my rescue Sky passed, she helped guide me to train Raye whilst she was a pup. That also inspired me to become a canine trainer and then pursue an FDSc in canine behavior after my last rescue dog's passing in October.

Remi was lovely with the whole family especially our Cockerpoo pup who loves her. She has given us the tools to help him become even a better pup. Remi has given us the confidence we needed as we felt really overwhelmed with a new puppy.we can’t recommend Remi highly enough.

Rima was absolutely brilliant with our puppy Lainey. She gave us so much help and confidence as owners and Lainey loved her. I don’t know how we would have survived those first months without her help. Brilliant communication and booking system too.  Highly recommended.

Rima was amazing. Showed me how to train my rescue dog Maisy with recall and to respond to her name and gave good ideas on mental stimulation for her. She also sent me all the notes afterwards. Highly recommended!

Rima was amazing! I contacted Rima because i needed help as a first time dog owner with the basic training needs for my puppy. Rima was compassionate, patient and always answered every single question i had. Riley is sooo much better now that we have completed the course and i feel much more confident moving forward.

I have worked with Rima for going on 3 years now, we recently spent 6 months in New York and even then we could not find anyone that came even close. Her knowledge and patience with training our 3 dogs has changed our whole mindset with regards to handling the dogs and understanding their behaviour. All 3 are rescue dogs and came from pretty rough backgrounds and she has completely transformed their behaviour and made us feel completely confident and safe in the whole process.
Thanks Rima

I’m so grateful to Rima for the amazing progress my dog Molly has made. Molly has always been anxious, and I often felt helpless seeing her stressed, but from our very first session Rima was patient, compassionate, and clearly understood what Molly needed to feel safe. She gave me practical tips I could use straight away, explained everything clearly, and was very knowledgeable. Molly is now more confident, calmer, and able to enjoy situations that used to overwhelm her, and I can’t recommend Rima enough for anyone with an anxious dog.

Rima is amazing - warm, compassionate and completely unfazed by any difficult canine behaviour, which means dogs take to her immediately. She helped us calm our dog on the basis of gentle handling and reward exercises, and got her to agree to wear a muzzle without resistance or distress. And all this without ever being punitive or harsh on the dog.

I got recommended Rima through a friend and he vouched she was the best in the business. I can now vouch for this too. I have a rescue bull breed and I have had so many setbacks, Rima has taught me so much as an owner and helped me to truly get to know my dog. I honestly couldn't thank Rima enough, she is calm, thoughtful, so so so knowledgeable, kind and just an all round fantastic behaviourist and trainer. I can't wait for the next 6 months of slow long term progress for my dog. Thanks Rima.

Rima is amazing and super friendly, she’s one of the best dog trainer I’ve ever took advise from. She has trained the dog I work with and had amazing improvements on the dog behavior inside and outside of the house. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a excellent dog trainer!!!

We had the most incredible experience with Even Better Dogs K9 Training and Behaviour, and I can't praise Rima enough for her expertise and dedication. Tuna, our furry family member, underwent a transformation thanks to Rima's amazing training skills. Not only did our pup learn a ton, but we, as dog parents, also gained invaluable insights and techniques.

Rima's passion for what she does truly shines through in every session. Her patience, knowledge, and positive energy made the training sessions enjoyable and effective.

If you're looking for a trainer who goes above and beyond, look no further than Even Better Dogs. Rima is not just a trainer; she's a dog whisperer who understands the unique needs of each canine companion. We are forever grateful for the positive impact she's had on our Tuna and our family.

Thank you, Rima and Even Better Dogs, for making our dog's training journey truly exceptional!
